gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads friendly and current, its lowercase e opening wide and its lines sitting snug under the ascenders. Plakkaat, meanwhile, draws a bent-straw thread of ink in heavy display capitals, so the two feel like a shout and a chat.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Plakkaat draws its heavy letters like fine rope, with terminals curling round almost to touch the stem. Schibsted Grotesk takes the opposite route, its e and a gaping open, so one closes up tight and the other lets the air in.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sen: Chunky shut-in capitals meet tall, open lowercase. Sen runs a single constant line around each letter and stops its curves before they turn inward, so a long passage in this plain sans moves along smoothly under Plakkaat's heavy heading.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sintony: Sintony has a chunky, tall midzone and curves that never clog, which makes this plain sans easy to follow. Plakkaat's closed, heavy letters sit above it, and the two keep each other honest.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sofia-sans: Modern and stencil-sharp, Sofia Sans stands its rounded lowercase tall with one uniform stroke and a clearly open side. Plakkaat brings the weight on top, so the sans-serif body can go modest in size without losing its footing.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Plakkaat's terminals sweep round almost to touch the stem, giving its heavy, low-contrast capitals a bent-straw look. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed can stay fairly compact, since its sans-serif lowercase is tall and its curves open wide.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sono: Sono spreads out with tall lowercase and generous letterspacing, each a left slightly ajar. Plakkaat, though, is better at heavy, closed-up statements, while Sono's job is the easy, approachable sans text that follows.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text reads like marker on paper, big-bodied lowercase with curve endings kept well apart. Stack Sans Text is what makes the pair work: its open, modern lines give Plakkaat's closed, heavy capitals room to breathe.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-sulphur-point: Approachable and sturdy, though the mood word here is professional: Sulphur Point has bulky lowercase and a steady marker-like line. Sulphur Point's open gaps in c, e, s and a are the pair's real strength against Plakkaat's closed, heavy capitals.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-tiktok-sans: Every Plakkaat stroke looks drawn in neon tube, one glowing thread bent into heavy, closed capitals with low contrast. It earns its keep big and short, while TikTok Sans handles the rest.
